arguments.subject: Re: Show dates for routing
arguments.body:
Hi Marta,

Here are the dates I played each show, January–June 2025:

January: 01-07 Foundry Lane Hall (Cambridge); 01-09 Riverbend Music Hall (Providence); 01-11 Harbor Room (Boston); 01-14 Corner Stage Cafe (Somerville); 01-16 Metro Arts Center (Boston); 01-20 Harbor Pier Pavilion (Portland); 01-22 Cloudline Livestream (Remote); 01-27 Lumen Lounge (Cambridge); 01-31 Beacon Theater (Cambridge); 01-31 Corner Stage Cafe (Cambridge)

February: 02-04 Foundry Lane Hall; 02-08 Corner Stage Cafe; 02-11 Harbor Room; 02-16 Metro Arts Center; 02-19 Cloudline Livestream; 02-24 Riverbend Music Hall; 02-27 Lumen Lounge

March: 03-03 Foundry Lane Hall; 03-06 Harbor Room; 03-08 Riverbend Music Hall; 03-14 Metro Arts Center; 03-18 Corner Stage Cafe; 03-21 Cloudline Livestream; 03-26 Lumen Lounge; 03-31 Beacon Theater

April: 04-01 Foundry Lane Hall; 04-05 Harbor Room; 04-09 Metro Arts Center; 04-12 Riverbend Music Hall; 04-17 Lumen Lounge; 04-23 Corner Stage Cafe; 04-28 Cloudline Livestream

May: 05-01 Foundry Lane Hall; 05-03 Corner Stage Cafe; 05-06 Harbor Room; 05-15 Cloudline Livestream; 05-19 Harbor Pier Pavilion; 05-23 Riverbend Music Hall; 05-27 Metro Arts Center; 05-30 Beacon Theater

June: 06-02 Foundry Lane Hall; 06-07 Harbor Room; 06-10 Riverbend Music Hall; 06-18 Cloudline Livestream; 06-21 Metro Arts Center; 06-24 Harbor Pier Pavilion; 06-28 Lumen Lounge (Somerville)

Cancelled shows are excluded.

Best,
Nadia

notes: The new action list is the frozen blueprint, including injected context.
Structured arguments are resolved in code from the schema, frozen step text, and prior results.
Common setup is resolved once and replayed with byte-identical arguments.
Stage 5 replays omit runtime message_user and shell steps; this receipt executes them.
Oracle walk() stores at most 1500 result characters. Walker.step results are stored in full.
A shell step whose exit code is 0 still fails when the workspace does not match the step effect.
Oracle scripts are model-drafted and may be shorter than the frozen blueprint.
